bar: 5m, bar-open timestamp, row available at bar close
labelled_rows: is_warmup == False only; earlier rows are read solely as causal history for rolling lookbacks
primary_venue: Bybit (open_interest, funding_rate, ofi, delta_cvd, impacts). bn_ columns never enter any rule; bn OI direction is emitted as a separate cross-check column only.
side_convention: LONG_* = longs are the crowded/stressed/liquidated side (adverse move is down); SHORT_* mirrors it (adverse move is up).
tie_break_within_level: LONG before SHORT (sides are mutually exclusive by construction; tie-break is defensive only)
missing_value_rule: any NaN input makes the condition that uses it false

rules.fps: fps_long = oi_zscore + funding_zscore; fps_short = oi_zscore - funding_zscore (frame z-scores: 2016-bar rolling, ddof=1)
rules.crowd_side: side of the most recent crowded bar within the last crowd_memory bars (t-crowd_memory+1 .. t inclusive); none if no crowded bar
rules.stress_window_values: anr_w = sum(atr_normalized_return, t-stress_window+1..t); doi_w = open_interest_t - open_interest_{t-stress_window}; ofi_w = mean(ofi, t-stress_window+1..t)
rules.LONG_STRESS: crowd_side == LONG AND anr_w <= -stress_return_atr AND doi_w < 0 AND ofi_w <= -ofi_threshold
rules.SHORT_STRESS: crowd_side == SHORT AND anr_w >= +stress_return_atr AND doi_w < 0 AND ofi_w >= +ofi_threshold
rules.fuel_pct: fraction of the last fuel_rank_window fuel values (inclusive of t, min_periods = window) that are <= fuel_t
rules.LONG_LIQUIDATION_CASCADE: LONG_STRESS conditions AND fuel_pct >= fuel_percentile AND delta_oi_t < 0 AND atr_normalized_return_t < 0 AND atr_normalized_return_t < atr_normalized_return_{t-1}
rules.SHORT_LIQUIDATION_CASCADE: SHORT_STRESS conditions AND fuel_pct >= fuel_percentile AND delta_oi_t < 0 AND atr_normalized_return_t > 0 AND atr_normalized_return_t > atr_normalized_return_{t-1}
rules.impact_ratio: LONG: sell_impact_t / max(sell_impact, t-impact_reference_window..t-1); SHORT: buy_impact_t / max(buy_impact, same window)
rules.LONG_EXHAUSTION: not a cascade at t AND a LONG_LIQUIDATION_CASCADE fired in t-exhaustion_after_cascade..t-1 AND oi_acceleration_t > 0 AND long impact_ratio <= exhaustion_impact_ratio AND ofi_t < 0
rules.SHORT_EXHAUSTION: not a cascade at t AND a SHORT_LIQUIDATION_CASCADE fired in t-exhaustion_after_cascade..t-1 AND oi_acceleration_t > 0 AND short impact_ratio <= exhaustion_impact_ratio AND ofi_t > 0
rules.long_short_ratio: secondary crowding confirmation, reported only (lsr_confirms column); never gates a primary state
rules.bn_cross_check: bn_doi_w = bn_sum_open_interest_t - bn_sum_open_interest_{t-stress_window}; reported separately to measure venue agreement on stress/cascade bars; never used in a rule

robustness_grid.design: one-at-a-time: each variant changes exactly one key threshold from the primary value; primary output is the only labelled file; variants report state counts only

no_tuning: Values chosen a priori from spec §3 scale (FPS ~2 = many longs) and feature definitions, without inspecting state distributions. Rare states are reported as findings, never re-tuned.
excluded: forward returns, PnL, trades, liquidation_* columns (all null), any bn_ column inside a rule
